topic: Apollo 11 flag knocked over by exhaust
hook: Your flag on the Moon fell over when you left.
title: Your Moon Flag Fell Over When You Left
description:
Buzz Aldrin said the lander's exhaust knocked the Apollo 11 flag over as they lifted off. It is one of the odd little details of leaving the Moon. Part of the If You Were in Space series.

#Shorts #Apollo11 #Moon
